events.label: Initial dependency indications received
events.description: Receives treatment, makeup-air controller-status, separate makeup-air delivered-response, shared-damper, and shared-path source reports.

events.label: Initial permissive indication received
events.description: Receives an external controller-reported process-permissive indication.

events.label: Process-enabled indication received
events.description: Receives a controller-reported process-enabled operating-context indication separately from the permissive. It does not prove process operation.

events.label: Duty request indication received
events.description: Receives the external controller's duty-fan request indication. FacilityOps does not issue the request.

events.label: Duty controller-execution indication received
events.description: Receives a controller-reported execution assertion separately from its request indication.

events.label: Initial duty-device indications received
events.description: Receives duty availability, run, fault, VFD state, speed, and separately sourced motor-current reports without inferring fan operation.

events.label: Initial process indications received
events.description: Receives delivered process-exhaust airflow, duct static, process-laboratory zone pressure, and both boundary differential-pressure reports.

events.label: New duty-device indications received
events.description: Receives new duty fault, availability, run, VFD, speed, and motor-current reports. No duty-loss inference is part of this replay.

events.label: New airflow and path indications received
events.description: Receives new shared airflow, duct-static, and damper reports without assigning a system-response conclusion.

events.label: New process-permissive indication received
events.description: Receives a new controller-reported process-permissive indication without naming its consequence.

events.label: Standby request indication received
events.description: Receives the external controller's standby-fan request indication. FacilityOps does not issue the request.

events.label: Standby controller-execution indication received
events.description: Receives a controller-reported standby execution assertion separately from its request indication.

events.label: Standby-device indications received
events.description: Receives standby availability, run, fault, VFD state, speed, and separately sourced motor-current reports without inferring fan operation.

events.label: New shared airflow and path indications received
events.description: Receives new shared airflow, duct-static, and damper reports. It does not determine a standby response.

events.label: New pressure indications received
events.description: Receives new process-laboratory zone and boundary differential-pressure reports without evaluating pressure direction, adequacy, or containment.

events.label: Asserted external human action recorded
events.description: Records only a fictional assertion that a person acted outside FacilityOps. The record does not prove authority, execution, causation, physical effect, restoration, or safety.

events.label: New dependency indications received after action context
events.description: Receives new treatment-availability, makeup-air controller-status, and makeup-air delivered-response reports. Their timing relative to the action record does not establish causation.

events.label: New fan indications received after action context
events.description: Receives new request, controller-execution, run, VFD, speed, electrical, fault, and availability reports without computing recovery.

events.label: New process indications received after action context
events.description: Receives new airflow, duct-static, zone-pressure, and both boundary reports through the pinned mapping transition without computing recovery.

events.label: New process-permissive indication received
events.description: Receives one new controller-reported process-permissive indication. FacilityOps records it only as a reported indication; this replay computes no physical recovery or authorization outcome.
